A LITTLE ABOUT ME

From an idea
to a working product.

I enjoy working across a product, from the interface people use to the services behind it.

At Talkual, I worked on an eCommerce platform with Vue.js and Nuxt.js, backed by Node.js, Strapi and PostgreSQL. This included recurring payments, automatic subscription renewals and delivery integrations.

My personal projects give me room to explore web and mobile development and take an idea through to deployment.

In teams, I enjoy turning requests into working features, collaborating on design and checking changes with tests.
